note: Both sets contain identical extraction errors regarding the Wiring Schedule symbols: they misbind Symbol 151 to Symbol 10's data ('#12/2WG'), misbind Symbol 150 to Symbol 151's description ('ARMORED CABLE'), and extract Symbol 150's actual data under a vague 'cable' entity. Both also omit the Notes and annotations outside the schedule. Set A is slightly better because it uses the more precise attribute 'conductor material' for Wiring 150, whereas Set B uses the vague 'material'.
remarks: Both sets fail to correctly map symbols 150, 151, and 10 from the text layer/image, likely due to layout confusion. Set B's use of 'material' instead of 'conductor material' is a minor quality degradation.
